title: Regular coefficient compatibility with geometric pullback
statement: For a totally disconnected normed field E, scheme maps p:V to X and a:Spec Omega to V for an arbitrary field Omega, a point z of Spec Omega, and a regular-module endomorphism f over the coefficient ring pulled back by p, the coefficient at z of the regular-module endomorphism conjugated along geometric pullback equals the value at a(z) of the continuous coefficient obtained by conjugating f by condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p. No evaluation functor H or normalized coordinate is involved.

proof.text: Identify regular-module conjugation by regular_conjugate, using the explicit restriction-of-scalars isomorphism and extension-of-scalars regular comparison. No coordinate transport or H is used.

Transpose the continuous-realization comparison by the composite point and scheme inverse-image adjunctions. Use its canonical adjoint-test equation, chartMate_homEquiv, and the explicit pullback-composition projections to prove the continuous pushforward square (realization_naturality). The construction works for E in Type u; no integral-only chart specialization is used.

Conjugate the square by the realization isomorphisms, using adjunction-unit naturality and conjugated_morphism_square. Apply it to the constant section 1 at the terminal pro-etale object. Its pullback has a canonical section over the source scheme; naturality along the terminal projection identifies evaluation at y upstairs with evaluation at a(y) downstairs. This proves scalar_naturality. Combine it with regular_conjugate and realization_conjugate to obtain geometric_scalar_value. In realization_conjugate use condensedFieldPullbackRealization_eq to expose the composite only where needed. Finally unfold only coefficientValue to pass from the folded scalar identity to the displayed raw evaluation. No coordinate transport or H is used.

proof_origin.note: A4: closed the raw-evaluation hole from the already proved geometric_scalar_value. The source of the kernel timeout was reduction of condensedFieldPullbackRealization at concrete evaluation. Its definition now selects the unique morphism equal to the original explicit composite, from a proved unique-existence theorem. The equation API proves realization_conjugate with controlled unfolding. The final simpa unfolds only coefficientValue. Full theorem and all new API declarations use only the three permitted axioms; zero new holes.

theorem condensedField_geometric_regular_coefficient
    (E : Type u) [NormedField E] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace E]
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] {X V : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : V ⟶ X) (a : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V) (z : Spec (.of Ω))
    (f : Mod.regular ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) X)) ⟶
      Mod.regular ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} p).obj
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) X))) :
    condensedFieldPointCoefficient E Ω z
      ((condensedFieldGeometricRegularIso (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) p a).inv ≫
        (condensedFieldGeometricModulePullback
          (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) p a).map f ≫
        (condensedFieldGeometricRegularIso (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj E) p a).hom) =
      (((inv (condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p) ≫ f.hom ≫
        condensedFieldPullbackRealization E p).hom.app
          (op (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 V)))) (ULift.up 1)).down (a z)
